question: What Is Cold Loop and Hot Loop Checking in Instrumentation?
body_html:
Cold loop and hot loop testing are the two stages of instrument loop checking during commissioning. Cold loop testing must be complete before hot loop testing begins.

PointCold loopHot loop
PhasePre-commissioningCommissioning
PowerDe-energised or panel power onlySystem powered, instruments live
ChecksWiring continuity, terminals, I/O card and tag mappingFull signal path and control loop function
SignalsNo live process signalsSimulated or real process signals
